name: Minimal steps line art (Hermes /minimalistic-graphics)
description: Thin outlined steps rise one by one, a white dot hops up them and an orbit draws around it at the top, with one quiet lowercase line. Hermes renders it with /minimalistic-graphics.

cautions: Research only: a Hermes render is never published.
Hermes renders with the claude-animation-skills skill installed there; record what it used.
Quiet and plain: lowercase, no emojis, no bold, no exclamation marks.
The idea is about steady progress (habits, compounding, patience).
Pure black, hairline white strokes, one solid white dot, one line of text.

curation.notes: Evidence for trial of a hermes pack (there is no Hermes in CI, so no CI render exists or is claimed). The skill is in the source repository at the pinned commit and the owner reports it works in Hermes. Every portal run of this pack is a research trial, never published.

hermes.input: The run's skill brief gives one shot per clip, in order, each with its seconds and the skill's JSON spec (brief.shots[i].spec), written by Hermes from the approved script and the research notes following the skill's spec and taste rules (lines (1 or 2 lowercase lines under about 30 characters), steps 3 to 7, light); never invent data the script and notes do not give. Render each spec with the skill, fit each clip to the shot's seconds (hold the last frame when the shot is longer, play it faster when shorter), cut them together, add the run's narration as the audio and burn the run's captions in the caption band. No pictures are made for this workflow.
hermes.output: One 1080x1920 H.264 MP4 at 30 fps with the narration, published under /clip/ on the media host. The studio then runs qc-video and the owner scores it on Review.
